messages:
raj.k: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of customer sessions where a streaming response got an early truncate from a region swap and the billing ledger shows both a provisional stream charge and a separate toolcall charge. Anyone seen this pattern?
helen: hmm, do you have an example trace id? :eyes:
raj.k: trace=tr-20260320-9a7c, stream_id=st-84f, toolcall_id=tc-84f. Root cause seems to be router moved the stream mid-request during model swap -> client reconnected and sent a toolcall which then got fully charged separately.
sam_g: can we confirm whether the initial stream had EOF vs soft-trim? billing differences depend on that.
raj.k: logs show early EOT from region-a: "EOT due to swap" then client resumed to region-b. Router emitted a fallback event.

matt: billing-bot: provisional_charge created for session st-84f amount=0.12 tokens (provisional)
highlight: billing-bot responded with provisional tag in invoice item.

helen: right — provisional charges are created for partial streams during soft-trim. If the resumed connection issues a toolcall that the runtime maps to a new session, we currently don't reconcile the provisional stream entry against the confirmed toolcall.
ops-jen: quick question: is the client sending the same toolcall_id on resume or generating a new one?
raj.k: new one. client SDK retries by creating a fresh toolcall object when reconnecting.
sam_g: that breaks idempotency. We should prefer client-supplied idempotency_key or resume_token to stitch. If missing, we end up double-counting.
helen: Agreed. Two immediate mitigations: 1) Router should try to preserve original stream->toolcall mapping when doing mid-request swap (best-effort) 2) Billing: mark provisional items as "reconcilable" and attempt auto-merge when a matching confirmed charge appears within X seconds.
matt: for (2) what's the match heuristic? same customer, overlapping timeframe, similar token delta, and identical resume_token or prefix capture?
raj.k: propose heuristic: same customer_id AND resume_token match OR (same model + first 64 bytes of text prefix match) within 120s. If matched, convert provisional->confirmed and deduct duplicate.

helen: prefix match is risky for privacy/false positives. Resume_token or explicit idempotency_key should be primary. Prefix fallback only for internal ops-to-ops reconciliation with human review.

sam_g: For the router approach: we can add a sticky metadata tag on the header for in-flight sessions: X-Inflight-Session: <session-id>. When swapping, carry header to new region so the runtime maps same session -> same toolcall. Minimal change.
ops-jen: That sounds doable. But rolling out sticky metadata might miss third-party clients. SDK fix would help too.
matt: console UX: we should surface provisional vs reconciled charges per session with a small timeline view (provisional -> reconciled/merged -> billed). PMs want deterministic behavior for enterprise audits.
raj.k: agreed. also need an ops runbook: identify cases where prefix-match caused wrong merges and revert.

helen: low-risk implementation plan: (a) short-term heuristics in billing reconciler prioritizing resume_token/idempotency_key; (b) router sticky header rollout to internal clients; (c) SDK update to preserve idempotency_key on reconnect; (d) console timeline + flag for "suspect double-charge".
sam_g: estimate: a) 2w, b) 1w canary, c) 1w SDK patch, d) 2w small UX.
matt: tagging for release train? put a canary to restricted enterprise accounts first.

raj.k: I'll open an RFC with the heuristic and sample replay script. Also attaching quick repro in case someone wants to test locally:

--- repro snippet ---
# repro: simulate early truncate and reconnect
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Idempotency-Key: id-1" -d '{"stream":true, "input":"long prompt..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | head -c 200
# then simulate reconnect without idempotency key
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"toolcall":true, "input":"remaining..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call
---

helen: nice. can you drop the trace id and logs into the RFC? i'll volunteer to implement the billing-reconciler side. :thumbsup:
raj.k: added. thanks.
matt: i'll add console timeline mockups to the doc.
ops-jen: pinging infra to watch for region-swap churn during canary.
billing-bot: note: created ticket BI-4023 for provisional-reconcile heuristic.
sam_g: cool. agree on priority. Let's also add metrics: provisional_count, reconcilation_rate, false_merge_rate.
helen: agreed. i'll draft alerts for spike in provisional_count.
raj.k: thanks all. we'll iterate in RFC. :pray:
